# Tugrul Guner

Canonical profile: https://tugrul.modepot.io/

Tugrul Guner is an AI Engineering Manager at CDAI in Toronto, Canada. He builds production AI systems and open-source developer infrastructure. He created ModePot, a family of projects exploring clear boundaries between deterministic software and agentic decisions.

## Work

- Dexpot: https://dexpot.modepot.io/
- Intpot: https://intpot.modepot.io/
- Summonpot: https://summonpot.modepot.io/
- LifePot: https://lifepot.modepot.io/
